title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
title_zh: SceneAnything：基于智能体的单视频大规模网格场景重建
abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.
abstract_zh: 从视频重建可编辑的 3D 场景，既要还原可见结构，也要合理补全未观测表面。直接让智能体编写场景构建程序，容易在布局、尺度和光照上出错。SceneAnything 通过明确的重建流程协调智能体、预训练视觉模型与图形工具，从真实或生成视频自动构建网格场景；结合视频生成模型后，还可实现从文本构建场景。负责统筹场景的智能体依据共享的相机、深度和分割估计规划布局，并将组件构建任务分派给编写参数化 Blender 程序的智能体。系统根据组件的可见性和拟合程度选择建模细节层级，将补全的不可见区域标记为推断结果，并为组装后的场景拟合光照、加入系统支持的运动。每次修订都经过程序化检查和独立视觉对比，通过验证的程序和经验可在后续场景中复用。作者在 100 个场景上进行了评估；子集对比显示，该方法的原始视角保真度高于直接使用智能体重建的基线，新视角内容相似度高于参与比较的视频到 3D 方法。
key_points_zh: 用共享的相机、深度与分割估计约束场景规划和组件建模，减少直接使用智能体重建时的布局与尺度偏差。
用参数化 Blender 程序构建可编辑组件，按可见性与拟合程度选择细节层级，并明确标记推断补全的区域。
通过程序化检查和独立视觉对比验证修订，跨场景复用通过验证的程序与经验。
在 100 个场景上评估；子集对比中，原始视角保真度优于直接智能体重建基线，新视角内容相似度优于所比较的视频到 3D 方法。
